name: Gezer
overview: Gezer was a significant Canaanite royal city whose king opposed Joshua but was defeated in battle, as seen when Horam king of Gezer came to help Lachish and was smitten by Joshua. Though allotted to the tribe of Ephraim and given to the Levites, the Canaanites were not fully expelled but remained to pay tribute and dwell among the Israelites. This city also faced conflict with the Philistines and was later fortified by Solomon, highlighting its ongoing strategic and spiritual importance in Israel's history.
